title: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warns of high leverage: 'Somebody will disrupt the market'
summary_full: JPMorgan Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon warned that leverage across financial markets remains elevated, adding that investors should be mindful that hidden borrowing could amplify market disruptions.
